exact_input_interpretation: binary64 values treated as exact rationals for context,month ranking and co-loss assessment
no_common_excess_loss_days_rule: retain posterior fractions without claiming safety

methodology.question: Can conditioning complete-expert outcome frequencies on observable equity and duration price context improve on the same unconditional contest-and-co-loss rule?
methodology.economic_role: Relative expert usefulness may persist differently when broad equity and duration are stronger or weaker than BIL. These are observable price proxies,not asserted causal inflation regimes.
methodology.contexts: Two strict positive126-session relative-return comparisons:SPY versus BIL and IEF versus BIL. Encode2*equity_positive+duration_positive. Exact cross-products of the known binary64 closes avoid floating tie ambiguity;equality is nonpositive.
methodology.monthly_credit: Each completed full source month assigns one total unit to the experts with the largest rounded12-decimal NET period relative. Compute products of(1+recordedNETreturn)as exact rationals,then round the scaled result to nearest even integer. Split tied credit exactly using60integer units,theLCMof1through6;60is representation,not a fitted parameter.
methodology.conditioning: The contextual learner assigns each matured month credit to the known preceding month-end context. The control pools every complete month. Both use a fixed categorical Dirichlet unit pseudocount per expert,not a constant-portfolio wealth integral.
methodology.maturity: Until126common NET source observations,main intentions are explicitly unscored equal-six. Full-month credit can mature earlier as statistical state. An unseen context uses its declared uniform categorical prior,not invented observations or a successful forecast.
methodology.co_loss: For each posterior prototype q,use126known NET excess-return observations. Select dates on which the exact-rational weighted prototype excess return is negative. Each l_i is the mean positive part of minus expert excess returns on those common dates;l_q=sum(q_i*l_i). Final expert fractions are proportional toq_i*exp(-l_i/l_q). If no common loss date exists,retainq with an explicit no-loss-information flag. Nonempty common loss dates require strictly positivel_q.
methodology.proxy_limit: The co-loss statistic is a conditional marginal nonoffsetting downside proxy with the reference loss-date set held fixed. Positive hedge gains are not credited. It is not hedge-adjusted portfolio loss,actual main marginal risk or a drawdown guarantee.
methodology.cost_and_dependence: Source returns already include original source costs;common loss dates depend on the joint source mixture. Main costs are charged only by actual original funded execution. The original monthly holdings band controls requests;there is no fabricated turnover cap or double charging of source fees.
methodology.numerics: Categorical credits and loss membership/statistics use exact rational interpretations of saved binary64 values. The risk transform is bounded by the positive categorical prior;independent scalar fractions and fixed50-digit exponentials check the final composition. No large passive-aggressive multiplier,solver or tolerance change.
